run_label_propagation: run label propagation to update object masks using rgb, depth, and robot pose data
run_save_rgb_seg: save an rgb image and its segmentation map to annotation_data for later retraining
run_save_annotations: convert saved segmentation maps and rgb images into COCO format for model retraining
run_retrain_detector: retrain a Detectron2 Mask R-CNN model from COCO annotations and evaluate average precision
run_get_offline_frame: read an offline rgb image and depth map from disk and encode them for processing
